name: Lux
notes: Opens with Final Spark (R) at t=0; its 1 s cast time holds the next attack for the full second, not just the default 0.25 s lockout, and its damage lands when the cast ends.

Light Binding (Q) is cast on cooldown; only the single dummy target is hit (its two-target cap and 'dummy' second missile do not matter against one target), and its damage lands on cast like the 0.25 s cast time implies.

Lucent Singularity (E) is cast on cooldown and immediately recast so it detonates the instant the projectile arrives instead of waiting out its 5 s duration; the travel delay before detonation is not modeled positionally and is taken as an assumed constant (see 'assumed').

Only Lucent Singularity's initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects (Spellblade/Muramana); the automatic/manual recast that actually deals the detonation damage does not, per the wiki.

Illumination applies/refreshes a 6 s mark on the dummy whenever Q lands, E detonates, or R lands. Only basic attacks and Final Spark consume the mark for its bonus magic damage (Q and E only apply/refresh it, per the wiki text).

Final Spark is assumed to also refresh the Illumination mark on the hit it lands (in addition to being able to consume an existing one), since the passive text describes 'Lux's abilities' generically as markers; this is an open reading and is flagged here.
Prismatic Barrier (W) only shields allies and never touches the dummy, so it is never cast.
Mana is not modeled: Lux's level-16 mana pool comfortably covers a 15 s rotation of Q/E/R casts.

assumed.why: delivery delay for Lucent Singularity before an immediate recast detonates it; the engine does not model cast distance, so this is taken as half of the ability's 1100-unit maximum range divided by its 1200 projectile speed (550/1200 s)
